changes.oldText: Command palette: Adds a Search button to the top bar and enables the Ctrl-K (Cmd-K on Mac) shortcut, which opens a palette for searching pages, tabs, and setting items, and for running quick actions such as switching the display mode or opening notifications. See Search for details.
